On 18 November 1962, sixty four years to this day, just over a hundred soldiers of 13 Kumaon fought the Chinese to the last man at Rezang La pass near Chushul. Watch Episode 1354 of , where ThePrint Editor-In-Chief Shekhar Gupta explains why the Battle of Rezang La is a moment of military glory India must never forget.
The episode was originally published on 24 November 2023.
